name: 旧厂房墙
prompt: Create ONE square opaque seamless material texture filling every pixel. Reference 1 and 2 are approved final hand-painted environment materials; match broad brush-shaped masses and restrained contrast. Other refs guide painted contours and volume but DO NOT draw any prop or character. Factory wall surface, upper two-thirds aged beige plaster, lower third dull teal paint with irregular peeling boundary and a little rust drip from an old removed fixture; no actual fixtures, text or graffiti. Orthographic flat material swatch; NO isometric diamond, camera perspective, pedestal, lighting gradient, border, transparent area, text, rendered room, object shadow, photoreal micro-noise or PBR specular. Large readable painted shapes; visible but subdued wear, not neat showroom. Edges should tile or mirror smoothly.
